web_blocks.html: Executive Thesis: Direxion Daily MSCI South Korea Bull 3X Shares (AMEX:KORU) is a single-day 300% leveraged ETF. Rafferty Asset Management advises the fund, which tracks the MSCI Korea 25/50 Index [1, 2]. In our price-blind audit (Pass 1), KORU earned a CYCLICAL_CONDITIONAL business-quality verdict and PASS_WITH_WATCH KPI health. Its daily plumbing works cleanly, backed by $985.42M in AUM, 32.57M average daily share volume, and four Tier-1 swap banks [1, 6]. In FY2025, collateral interest covered net expenses to produce $2.00M in net investment income [1]. Yet 3x daily compounding creates severe volatility drag, including a -76.86% drop in FY2022 and a February 2025 1-for-10 reverse split [1, 3]. Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix represent 42% to 48% of the capped index [4].

Dual Verdict (As of November 13, 2026 Close: $7.68): Our New-Capital Verdict is REJECTED. The rejection rests on three pillars: TREND, VALUATION, and CASH_FLOW. KORU is in confirmed Stage 4, down -88.00% from its $63.98 52-week high and -69.66% below its $25.31 30-week SMA [8]. Over the past 12 months, unleveraged EWY gained +48.59% while KORU lost -10.39% due to 224.1% realized volatility [8, 9]. Our Current Holding Action is EXIT_IMMEDIATELY on all 471.984153 shares in Robinhood. That stake holds $3,624.84 in market value against a $5,457.78 cost basis, an unrealized loss of -$1,832.94 (-33.58%). It carries a 4.09% portfolio weight and an extreme 8.53 effective beta. We redeploy the freed $3,624.84 into 50% CASH ($1,812.42) during a US Correction with 6 distribution days. The remaining 50% goes to MSFT ($1,812.42), a Stage 2 Shortlist leader at $523.88 with a $660.00 target and 1.90:1 asymmetry [23]. Unleveraged Korea peer EWY ($142.78) receives 0% because it sits in Stage 1 (Basing) below its 30W SMA ($175.43) [9].

book_paragraphs: Welcome to the Research Desk underwriting monograph for KORU—the Direxion Daily MSCI South Korea Bull 3X Shares ETF. Before we walk through ten chapters of filings, swap schedules, semiconductor cycles, and price action, let us put our cards on the table with complete clarity.

We built this analysis in two strictly separated passes so that a falling stock price could never seduce our business judgment. In Pass 1, completely blind to the $7.68 share price, we examined KORU's SEC Form N-CSR filings, swap counterparties, collateral structure, and the MSCI Korea 25/50 Index. We found a well-oiled institutional derivative wrapper—$985.42 million in assets, 32.57 million shares of daily liquidity, four Tier-1 swap banks, and positive net investment income in FY2025—wrapped around a hyper-concentrated Korean semiconductor index where Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix command 42% to 48% of the weight. That earned a CYCLICAL_CONDITIONAL rating: viable only for short, low-volatility uptrends, and structurally hostile to long-term compounding.

In Pass 2, we examined the November 13, 2026 market ledger, and the verdict became unmistakable. KORU closed at $7.68, down 88.00% from its 52-week high of $63.98 and nearly 70% below its 30-week moving average of $25.31. Even as unleveraged EWY gained +48.59% over the past year, KORU lost -10.39% because 224.1% realized volatility turned daily compounding into a relentless tax. Both KORU and EWY sit in confirmed Stage 4 downtrends while the broader S&P 500 trades in a Correction with six distribution days.

Consequently, our New-Capital Verdict is REJECTED across every time horizon. And for the 471.984153 shares currently held in your Robinhood account ($3,624.84 market value against a $5,457.78 cost basis, carrying an extreme 8.53 effective beta), our Holding Action is EXIT_IMMEDIATELY. We redeploy the freed $3,624.84 prudently: 50% into CASH to respect the Correction regime, 50% into Stage 2 Shortlist leader Microsoft (MSFT) at $523.88 with a $660.00 target, and 0% into EWY until South Korean equities finish their Stage 4 decline and build a new Stage 2 base. Let us now walk through the full evidence, chapter by chapter.

book_callouts.title: NARRATOR'S REFLECTION
book_callouts.text: The hardest discipline in portfolio management is separating a good macro story from a broken vehicle. You can respect Korean AI memory valuations and still refuse to own a 3x daily-resetting ETF in Stage 4.

section_takeaway: New capital: REJECTED. Existing 471.984153 Robinhood shares: EXIT_IMMEDIATELY and redeploy 50% CASH / 50% MSFT / 0% EWY.

book_subsections.title: 0.1 What KORU Is and Why It Failed the Price-Unlocked Gate
paragraphs: At its core, KORU is an institutional swap-and-collateral machine managed by Rafferty Asset Management under the Direxion Shares ETF Trust. It holds roughly half its net assets in EWY shares and the remainder in Treasury money market funds pledged as collateral to four major swap dealers—J.P. Morgan, Citibank, Barclays, and Bank of America Merrill Lynch—to deliver 300% of the single-day return of the MSCI Korea 25/50 Index. Because Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix dominate South Korea's equity market, those two semiconductor giants represent 42% to 48% of KORU's underlying exposure.

While the fund's daily plumbing is liquid and well-capitalized at $985.42 million in AUM, its 3x daily reset is mathematically unforgiving over multi-month holding periods. Over the past 12 months through November 13, 2026, EWY rose +48.59% while KORU fell -10.39%. Combine that structural variance drag with a Stage 4 breakdown (-69.66% below its 30-week SMA) and a US Correction regime, and KORU fails every new-capital and holding-retention gate.

book_subsections.title: 0.2 Exact Portfolio Action & Capital Redeployment Summary
paragraphs: For new capital, our verdict is REJECTED across short-term, medium-term, and long-term horizons. For your existing Robinhood holding of 471.984153 shares ($3,624.84 market value, -$1,832.94 unrealized loss, 4.09% weight, 8.53 effective beta), our instruction is EXIT_IMMEDIATELY. We redeploy 100% of the freed $3,624.84 into 50% Cash ($1,812.42) to respect market breadth weakness and 50% MSFT ($1,812.42) at $523.88 in Stage 2, while keeping unleveraged EWY at 0% until Seoul breaks out into Stage 2.

book_subsections.title: 0.3 How to Read This Monograph
paragraphs: Chapters 1 through 6 walk you through KORU's entire price-blind anatomy: how Direxion launched the fund in 2013, how its swap agreements and EWY holdings actually operate, how every $100 of fund economics flows through Rafferty Asset Management's books, and why its 10-year return history diverges so sharply from the underlying Korean equity market. Chapters 7 through 9 then unlock the November 13, 2026 market tape to test valuation, Stage 4 technical structure, options convexity, and our exact portfolio exit and redeployment plan.

Every number, filing reference, and technical level in both editions is synchronized to the November 13, 2026 market close, giving you a single, unbiased blueprint for protecting capital and redeploying into higher-probability Stage 2 setups.
